sentences: This bill would create a Banking Commission of Inquiry with the same powers as a Royal Commission.

A Treasurer-appointed Commissioner would investigate practices of authorised deposit-taking institutions (ADIs) such as not passing on full cash rate cuts, excessive mortgage margins, and lending that borrowers cannot service.
The Commission could also examine remuneration cultures, non-recourse lending, mortgage insurance regulation, and establishing a tribunal to oversee ADI behaviour and provide legal aid.
changes: Establishes a Banking Commission of Inquiry with Royal Commission powers.
Empowers a Commissioner appointed by the Treasurer to investigate specified ADI and lending practices.
May lead to a tribunal with oversight and legal aid functions.
summary.affected: Authorised deposit-taking institutions (ADIs), their directors, managers, staff, and borrowers.
